blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Barangay Canduman in Mandaue City is strengthening its flood preparedness as the barangay remains on alert for heavy rains and possible flooding, with its disaster response personnel on standby 24/7 to respond to emergencies. Barangay Captain Dante Borbajo said personnel are expected to immediately respond to calls from residents, particularly during periods of intense rainfall. “As always, 24/7 gyud na sila ready kay wala man ta kahibaw sa katalagman.
